rows.label: Private chef · cost
rows.prompt: How much does a private chef cost in Dubai per dinner and per month, and which companies publish their prices?
rows.answer:
Here's a breakdown of what private chefs in Dubai typically cost, and which providers actually publish their pricing.

## Per-Dinner Pricing

Prices vary a lot depending on the group size, menu complexity, and the chef's caliber:

- **Take a Chef** (takeachef.com/en-ae/private-chef/dubai) publishes clear per-head tiers: 
booking prices range from 305 AED to 482 AED per person, with rates of 305 AED for 13+ people, 314 AED for 7-12 people, and higher for smaller groups.


- **Chef On Demand** (chefondemand.it) is one of the most transparent, publishing detailed tiered menus: 
around AED 408 per person for an Essential dinner (4 courses, 6 guests), dropping to about AED 351 per head at 8 guests; a Gourmet menu (5 courses) runs around AED 477 per person at 6 guests, and a Luxury menu (6+ courses) about AED 627 per person at the same group size.
 They also note 
a four-guest dinner runs higher per head, and premium tasting menus can pass AED 1,000 per person.
 Surcharges apply too — 
Christian and public-holiday surcharges add 50% in Dubai, and Ramadan iftar or New Year's Eve bookings are custom-quoted, never a flat rate.


- **Tip a Chef** (tipachef.com/private-chef/dubai) gives a broader event-based range: 
for a private dinner event, expect AED 1,500–AED 5,000 depending on guest count and menu complexity.


- **MiumMium** (miummium.com/en-ae/personal-chef-dubai) quotes in USD: 
the average sum paid over the last few years for their Personal Chef services was $50.65 + tip per person, with the lowest priced meals in the low thirties and the highest over $150 per guest.


- General market estimates (e.g., from Solai and Alliance Recruitment) suggest a wider spread: 
for smaller gatherings or simple meals, a private chef in Dubai may charge starting from around 300 to 600 AED per person, while a more refined multi-course experience typically ranges from 600 to 1,200 AED per person.
 At the top end, 
high-end private chefs, especially those with fine dining backgrounds or international experience, may charge 1,200 to 3,000 AED or more per person.


## Monthly / Ongoing Pricing

- **Tip a Chef** publishes ongoing service rates: 
meal prep services run AED 900–AED 2,000 per day, while a full-time private chef in Dubai earns AED 180,000–AED 380,000 per year
 (roughly AED 15,000–31,600/month as a salaried live-in or full-time hire).

- **Alliance Recruitment Agency** (alliancerecruitmentagency.ae) gives a lower live-in salary estimate: 
for a chef who lives with the family as a housing member, salaries may vary from AED 3,000 to AED 3,500 per month
 — this figure likely reflects a live-in domestic staff arrangement rather than a professional trained chef, so treat it as a low-end benchmark. They also separately note 
an average price for a private chef may cost AED 400 to AED 500 per person
 for one-off events.

## Companies That Publish Transparent Pricing

If you want upfront, published rates rather than "request a quote" pages, these three are your best bets:

2. **Take a Chef** – takeachef.com/en-ae/private-chef/dubai — publishes a clear per-person price table based on group size.

rows.answer:
Based on my research, here are several Dubai caterers that offer dedicated vegan/plant-based menus for private events:

**1. Baguette Catering** – www.baguette.ae

They handle everything from weddings and corporate functions to private dinners with plant-based catering services, and a vegan buffet or a plated experience can be arranged depending on your event.
 
They provide complete vegan catering solutions for gatherings of all sizes, from intimate parties to large-scale celebrations.


**2. Cedar Tree Catering** – www.cedartreecatering.ae

They offer more than just menu items, providing complete event support with a strong focus on quality and service, from planning and preparation to on-site execution.
 
In Dubai, they position their vegetarian and vegan catering as a solution for diverse expectations while maintaining high culinary standards, for events ranging from business functions to private celebrations.


**3. Taste Studio** – www.tastestudio.ae
This caterer specifically emphasizes strict vegan standards rather than relabeled vegetarian food. 
They highlight "genuine vegan options, meaning no dairy or egg — not vegetarian dishes relabelled."
 
They note that in a Dubai guest list, vegetarians are frequently 20–40% of the room with vegans a growing share, so they build vegetarian and vegan dishes across every course — mezze, salads, mains, sides and desserts — rather than treating it as a single fallback dish.


**4. MyGovindas** – www.mygovindas.com
A sattvic/vegan Indian specialist. 
They serve cuisine from India prepared from 100% pure, fresh vegetables, with tons of vegan options such as Kofta, Rajma, Veg Biryani, and Dal Makhani.
 
They cater corporate functions, family gatherings, festive celebrations, weddings, and private parties.


**5. Bikanervala UAE** – www.bikanervala.ae
While primarily a vegetarian specialist (not exclusively vegan), 
they offer 100% vegetarian catering in the UAE with customized menus and premium service for weddings, corporate events, or private parties.
 Ask them specifically to confirm which dishes are fully vegan (dairy/ghee-free), as their default menu is vegetarian rather than vegan.

**6. Wild & The Moon** (Alserkal Avenue) – worth checking directly

One reviewer described it as a must-visit for clean eating and sustainability, noting the entire menu is 100% organic, plant-based, gluten-free, and free from refined sugar.
 This suggests it could be a strong option if you want a fully plant-based aesthetic for a private event, though you'd want to confirm directly whether they do off-site private event catering.

**Tips for booking:**
- Since many Dubai caterers offer vegan as an *option* within a broader menu rather than being 100% vegan-only kitchens, it's worth explicitly asking each provider to confirm (a) no cross-contamination with dairy/egg/meat prep, and (b) a full vegan menu across every course (starters, mains, desserts), not just a token dish.
- Companies like Taste Studio explicitly flag this distinction, which may make them a safer choice if a fully vegan menu (not just vegetarian) is essential for your event.

Would you like me to look into pricing, minimum guest counts, or specific cuisine styles (e.g., Indian, Middle Eastern, international) for any of these?

AHS Catering and Events is a leading Dubai catering company with more than 20 years of excellence in luxury weddings, corporate functions, and private celebrations, crafting tailored menus that blend authentic Middle Eastern flavors with refined international cuisine, all prepared in halal-certified kitchens.
 
They accommodate all dietary requirements including vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, halal, and allergen-specific menus.


2. **Captain Zaiqey** — [captainzaiqey.com](https://captainzaiqey.com/)

Captain Zaiqey guarantees 100% halal-certified ingredients from approved suppliers with strict halal preparation protocols.
 
It's a trusted halal catering company in Dubai offering authentic Mughlai, Indian, Pakistani, and Afghani cuisine for weddings, corporate events, and private parties.
 They also offer 
outdoor catering in Dubai for weddings, corporate events & parties with halal menus, BBQ, buffets, and more, having served 500+ events.


3. **Buffestra Catering** — [buffestra.ae](https://buffestra.ae/)

Buffestra combines culinary expertise with event-focused catering support for events ranging from intimate private gatherings to large corporate and public events, and can accommodate halal, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and other dietary preferences.
 They even offer 
yacht catering for private celebrations, corporate yacht events, and other occasions on Dubai's waters
 if you want something more unique.

4. **Catering Service Dubai** — [cateringservicedubai.com](https://cateringservicedubai.com/)

Catering Service Dubai ensures fully halal buffet catering using certified ingredients and follows all local health and religious standards for complete peace of mind.
 They provide 
professional private catering with bespoke menus and seamless service for events of all sizes
 and note 
compact, stylish setups for intimate gatherings or office events.


5. **Elements Catering** (mentioned via Catering Dubai roundup)

Elements prides itself on being a boutique caterer that focuses on "Seasonal and Fresh" ingredients, with over 20 years of experience catering for major brands like Gucci and Red Bull, and reviews frequently mention their high hygiene standards of their HACCP-certified kitchen.
 (Worth confirming halal certification directly with them for your specific event.)

**Tips before booking:**
- 
Most catering companies in Dubai serve 100% halal food per UAE regulations, but it's wise to confirm halal certification directly when booking.

- 
For small private events, plan for a 2–4 week lead time, and book earlier during peak seasons like October–April, Ramadan, Eid, and Diwali, as top caterers fill up quickly.


I'd recommend reaching out to 2–3 of these directly, sharing your guest count and menu preferences, and asking them to confirm their halal certification body (e.g., ESMA or Dubai Municipality-approved) in writing.

rows.label: Dining · romantic dinner at home
rows.prompt: I want a private chef to cook a romantic anniversary dinner at our apartment in Dubai. Who offers this? Names and websites.
rows.answer:
Here are some private chef providers in Dubai who can arrange an in-home romantic anniversary dinner:

1. **Take a Chef** – takeachef.com/en-ae/private-chef/dubai

They organize private chef services for important occasions like birthdays and anniversaries, letting you book a private chef in Dubai for custom meals prepared in your home.
 
The service includes menu customization, ingredient purchasing, mise en place, preparation at your home, complete table service, and setup/cleaning of the kitchen and used spaces.
 
You choose the menu and they take care of shopping, cooking, serving, and cleanup.


2. **Chef at Home Dubai** – chefathome-dubai.com

Led by Chef Beram, who has over 20 years in prestigious kitchens, this service is positioned as Dubai's finest private chef for hire, offering luxury private dining at home across Dubai and the UAE.
 
Whether it's an intimate anniversary dinner or a corporate gathering, Chef Beram ensures every plate reflects quality and craft.
 A past client noted: 
"Chef Beram turned our private anniversary dinner into a world-class 5-star experience right in our dining room," with standout plating and Wagyu steak quality.


3. **Cedar Tree Catering** – cedartreecatering.ae/anniversary-dinner-catering-in-dubai

Catering Dubai's celebrations since 2007 and Dubai Municipality approved/SGS accredited, this company specializes in tailored set menus, private chefs, plated service and coordinated styling for intimate occasions.
 
They shape the menu around your story and handle the evening end to end.
 For a two-person anniversary meal, they suggest 
a three- or four-course plated set menu (for example seared scallops or burrata to start, beef tenderloin or sea bass as a main, and a shared dessert) with a sparkling grape or mocktail pairing.


**Recommendation:** For a truly private, chef-in-your-kitchen experience, **Chef at Home Dubai** or **Take a Chef** are your best bets since they specialize specifically in cooking on-site at your apartment. If you'd also like help with decor (candles, flowers, table styling) alongside the meal, **Cedar Tree Catering** offers a more all-in-one styled experience.

A few practical tips: book at least a few days in advance, confirm whether tableware/glassware are provided (Take a Chef notes these are typically not included), and discuss any dietary preferences or a signature dish you'd like featured (e.g., Wagyu steak, seafood, etc.) when you inquire.

They let you book a private chef in Palm Jumeirah who prepares a bespoke menu on-site and serves your group, with 2026 prices roughly AED 400 to AED 1,000 per guest depending on tier and party size.

They specifically list Palm Jumeirah villas among their coverage areas, along with Emirates Hills and Jumeirah & Dubai Hills residences.

5. **Take a Chef** – www.takeachef.com

Most guests book chefs to come directly to their homes across Dubai — whether in an apartment in Downtown, a villa in Jumeirah, or anywhere in between — and the chef brings everything, cooks on-site, serves, and cleans up after.


Additionally, if you're staying at a resort villa rather than a private residence, **One&Only The Palm** (www.oneandonlyresorts.com) offers

For a long-term, live-in arrangement, Ocean Earth Chefs and ChefMaison seem best suited given their emphasis on ongoing placements, while Chef On Demand and Culinary Essence are geared more toward one-off villa dinners and events.
